doc: Looks up D_80073740[idx] (idx = s16 arg0) as a flags value, builds a request struct on the stack (unk0=flags, unk4=0), calls func_8005FA34(&req) which fills in two s16 output fields (unk8/unkA), then rescales each by an arithmetic shift-right-by-7 (s16 >> 7) and stores the results through the *a1/*a2 out-pointers. Always returns 0.

calls: func_8005FA34(S_8005C784 *a0) -- takes a pointer to a partially-filled request/response struct; caller sets unk0 (flags value) and unk4 (=0 here), callee writes back unk8/unkA (s16 outputs). Return value unused/void.
